source.title: A 10-year-old CNN outperforms frontier LLMs for skin cancer diagnosis
source.author: sungam

title.zh: 皮肤癌AI诊断：老CNN胜过前沿大模型
title.en: Skin Cancer AI: Old CNN Beats Frontier LLMs

excerpt.zh: 皮肤癌AI诊断测试显示，微调十年的Inception v3在200个活检确诊皮损上胜过两款前沿大模型，但样本有限且不能替代临床判断。
excerpt.en: A skin cancer AI test found an old CNN outperformed two frontier LLMs on 200 biopsy-confirmed lesions, but the sample is small and not clinical guidance.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: 皮肤癌AI诊断的对比结果
这项皮肤癌AI诊断测试比较了GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.1和一款微调后的Inception v3卷积神经网络。研究者从MILK10k公开数据集中随机抽取200个经组织病理学确认的皮损，要求三种系统从六类诊断中选择最可能的一项，并判断是否可以安全离院、活检或随访。
text.en: This skin cancer AI test compared GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, and a fine-tuned Inception v3 convolutional neural network. The researcher randomly selected 200 lesions from the public MILK10k dataset, all confirmed by histopathology, and asked each system to choose among six diagnoses and recommend discharge, biopsy, or follow-up.

text.zh: CNN首次诊断答对125例，即62%；两款大模型分别答对84例和85例，均为42%。允许给出第二选择后，CNN覆盖173例，两个大模型分别为134例和138例。CNN在识别黑色素瘤和良性皮损方面总体更强，但并非每一类都领先。
text.en: The CNN gave the correct first-choice diagnosis for 125 cases, or 62%; the two LLMs scored 84 and 85 cases, both 42%. When a second choice was allowed, the CNN covered 173 cases, compared with 134 and 138 for the LLMs. It was generally stronger on melanoma and benign lesions, although it did not lead in every category.

text.zh: 专业模型为何仍有优势
text.en: Why a specialized model still led

text.zh: 这款CNN使用公开皮肤科图像进行微调，重点结合临床照片与皮肤镜图像；测试样本及同一患者的其他图像在训练前被排除。它的架构始于2015年，训练约二十分钟，却能在手机浏览器中运行，说明针对明确视觉任务的专用模型可能比通用语言模型更合适。
text.en: The CNN was fine-tuned on public dermatology images and combined clinical photographs with dermoscopic views; the test lesions and other images from the same patients were excluded before training. Its architecture dates to 2015 and it was trained for roughly twenty minutes, yet it can run in a phone browser. The result suggests that a specialized model may fit a focused visual task better than a general language model.

text.zh: 皮肤癌AI诊断的关键限制
text.en: Key limits of the skin cancer AI test

text.zh: 结论不能直接推广到临床。样本只有200个皮损，其中黑色素瘤仅30例；每个大模型案例也只运行一次，输出可能随运行变化。更重要的是，CNN在预设阈值下漏掉了30例黑色素瘤中的18例，尽管它总体更准确。研究者还指出，这只是基线架构，先进的皮肤癌系统使用更大数据集、图像变换器或集成模型。把大模型当作患者咨询时，它们几乎总是建议就医，这种谨慎也不能等同于准确诊断。最终，结果更适合说明模型选择和评测设计的重要性，而不是证明老模型可以替代皮肤科医生。
text.en: The result should not be generalized directly to clinical care. The sample contained only 200 lesions, including 30 melanomas, and each LLM case was run once, so its output may vary. More importantly, at its preset threshold the CNN discharged 18 of the 30 melanomas, despite its higher overall diagnostic accuracy. The researcher also notes that this is only a baseline architecture; stronger dermatology systems use larger datasets, vision transformers, or ensembles. When prompted as patients, the LLMs advised seeing a doctor in nearly every case, but caution is not the same as diagnostic accuracy. The study is therefore best read as evidence about model choice and evaluation design, not as support for replacing dermatologists with an old network.
